title: Canonical toric resolution of Gale-dual type-A polytopes is small

difficulty_reason: The proof must identify every toric stratum with a naked directed graph, identify the fiber cones by preservation of directed cycles, and establish the strict twice-fiber-dimension inequality for every nonempty face. Section 4.3 supplies this Gale-dual combinatorial geometry argument, substantially beyond an application of the decomposition theorem.
